$comment: Size ceiling per built image, in megabytes as `docker image inspect --format {{.Size}}` reports them. `pnpm compose:boot` fails when a built image exceeds its ceiling. Measured 2026-10-22 on amd64 after the runtime stages moved to `pnpm deploy --prod` (api 454, worker 242, migrate 294, runner 3083, web 72, edge 70; before: api 2320, worker 2740, migrate 2740, runner 4680), each ceiling about 20% above the reading. The runner is large because it carries Chromium, Firefox and WebKit with their system libraries; a new dependency that doubles another image is the regression this exists to show.
